CHN.note: Production 51.28 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024) - world's largest, ~half of global output. Exports 981 kt, imports vol from ITC 2024 (US$218M); world's top exporter by volume in 2024.

USA.note: Production ~5.03 Mt (FAOSTAT/USApple 2024). Exports 897 kt (ITC 2024, #3 exporter); imports mostly counter-seasonal from Chile/NZ.

POL.note: Production ~4.2 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024), EU's largest apple grower. Exports 784 kt (ITC 2024, #4 exporter by volume); imports minor.

TUR.note: Production ~4.85 Mt (FAOSTAT 2023/24). Exports 317 kt (ITC 2024); small importer.

ITA.note: Production ~2.4 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 945 kt (ITC 2024, #2 by volume, #1 by value US$1.12bn); imports ~107 kt re-export/early.

IRN.note: Production ~2.34 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 299 kt (ITC 2024) - fell ~53% YoY; minor imports.

IND.note: Production ~2.41 Mt (FAOSTAT 2023/24). Net importer: imports ~300 kt (ITC 2024 value US$424M, #3 importer); negligible exports.

FRA.note: Production ~1.5 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 333 kt (ITC 2024, #8); imports ~100 kt (US$106M).

CHL.note: Production ~1.1 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 554 kt (ITC 2024, #6 by volume, up 18% YoY); minor imports.

ZAF.note: Production ~1.2 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 671 kt (ITC 2024, #5 by volume); minor imports.

NZL.note: Production ~0.56 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 378 kt (ITC 2024, #7 by volume); near-zero imports - export-oriented.

DEU.note: Production ~1.0 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). World's largest apple importer by value (US$644M, ITC 2024); re-exports ~150 kt within EU.

RUS.note: Production ~1.7 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Major importer (US$236M, ITC 2024); imports ~400 kt mainly from Moldova, Serbia, CIS.

EGY.note: Production ~0.7 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Large importer (US$195M, ITC 2024) supplied by Italy, Poland, Greece, Lebanon.

GBR.note: Production ~0.45 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). #2 importer by value (US$453M, ITC 2024); supplied by France, South Africa, Italy, NZ.

NLD.note: Production ~0.4 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Major re-export hub: imports ~300 kt, re-exports ~250 kt across EU (Rotterdam gateway).

ESP.note: Production ~0.5 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports 108 kt (ITC 2024); net importer of ~250 kt (US$213M).

ARG.note: Production ~0.9 Mt (FAOSTAT 2024). Exports ~80 kt (Rio Negro Valley) mainly to Brazil/Paraguay; minor imports.

flows.note: FAOSTAT 2024 detailed trade matrix (TCL), importer-reported, HS080810 fresh apples. Largest US export corridor; Mexico is a top-importer of US apples (ITC Trade Map 2024 ranks Mexico among top apple buyers by value, ~US$316M). Consistent with FAOSTAT.

FAOSTAT 2024 detailed trade matrix (TCL), importer-reported, HS080810 fresh apples. Italy is Germany's #1 apple supplier (US$310M, ITC Trade Map 2024); largest single bilateral apple flow into the EU. Corroborated.

FAOSTAT 2024 detailed trade matrix (TCL), importer-reported, HS080810 fresh apples. Iran among India's largest apple suppliers (~US$82M, ITC Trade Map 2024). Corroborated; Iran export volumes fell sharply YoY (-53% per ITC).
FAOSTAT 2024 detailed trade matrix (TCL), importer-reported, HS080810 fresh apples. China is the dominant SE-Asia apple supplier; Thailand a top Chinese-apple market. Consistent with ITC 2024.

rankings.exportSrc: ITC Trade Map / FAOSTAT 2024 (HS080810), export shipment weight
rankings.importSrc: ITC Trade Map 2024 value ranking (HS080810); volumes are estimates from value at country unit-price bands - see note
rankings.note: Exporter volumes are ITC 2024 shipment weights (top 5: China 981, Italy 946, USA 897, Poland 784, South Africa 671 kt). Importer rows ordered by ITC 2024 import value (Germany US$644M, UK US$453M, India US$424M, Vietnam US$377M, Indonesia US$318M, Mexico US$317M); kt figures are approximate volume estimates and should be read as indicative, not measured.

companies.name: VOG (Marlene)
companies.note: One of Europe's largest apple cooperatives; ~4,000 South Tyrol growers, Marlene brand sold in 70+ countries. Italy is the #1 apple exporter by value (US$1.12bn, 2024).
companies.improve: Add cooperative throughput tonnage and per-variety split (Gala, Golden Delicious, Fuji) when published.

companies.name: T&G Global
companies.note: New Zealand's largest apple producer; owns premium club varieties Envy and Jazz, grown under licence across NZ, Chile, USA, South Africa, UK, Australia. Subsidiary of BayWa Group.
companies.improve: Add annual Envy/Jazz export volume and licensed-acreage by country.

companies.name: Stemilt Growers
companies.note: Family-owned Washington State grower-packer-shipper; pioneer of organic apples; ships premium and organic apples globally. USA is #3 apple exporter by volume (897 kt, 2024).
companies.improve: Add Stemilt packout volume and organic share.

companies.name: Rajpol
companies.note: Major Polish apple producer-exporter (est. 1996), ~70,000 t fruit/yr with ~40% exported to EU retail, Middle East and Asia. Poland is #4 apple exporter by volume (784 kt, 2024).
companies.improve: Confirm latest apple-only export tonnage versus total fruit throughput.

companies.name: Tru-Cape Fruit Marketing
companies.note: South Africa's largest apple & pear exporter (~20% of national production); owned by Two-a-Day and Ceres Fruit Growers; exports to ~108 countries (>18M cartons). ZAF is #5 apple exporter by volume (671 kt, 2024).
companies.improve: Split apple vs pear carton volumes and destination-market shares.

companies.name: Greenyard Fresh
companies.note: Pan-European fresh-produce distributor sourcing and re-exporting apples across EU and from southern-hemisphere suppliers; key Benelux re-export hub linking Belgium/Netherlands gateways.
companies.improve: Isolate apple line volume from the broader fresh-produce portfolio.

global.src: FAOSTAT production 2020-2024; ITC Trade Map export shipment-weight 2020-2024 (HS080810)
global.note: Production (FAOSTAT, fresh apples, kt): rises from ~86.4 Mt (2020) to ~97.8 Mt (2024), China ~half. Consumption approximated as production minus net trade/processing losses. Global export shipment weight fell from 8.70 Mt (2020) to 7.72 Mt (2024) per ITC (-11% over 5 yr). Note USDA PSD uses a narrower commercial-crop basis (world ~81-86 Mt) - this series follows FAOSTAT for consistency with the seed.

forecast.method: OECD-FAO Outlook 2024-2033 does not break out apples separately; rates set from FAOSTAT/ITC recent apple trend (production ~flat-to-modestly-up, traded volume ~flat). 2030 = 2024 x (1+rate)^6
